# google-indexing-api

> Async Rust client for the Google Indexing API v3. Notify Google that a URL was updated or deleted (single request or a batch of up to 100), and fetch the notification metadata Google holds for a URL. Intended for JobPosting (Google for Jobs) and BroadcastEvent pages.

Crate name: `google-indexing-api`. Public items: `GoogleIndexingApi::url_notifications()` returns `UrlNotificationsApi` with `publish`, `get_metadata`, and `batch`; `UrlNotificationsType::{UPDATED, DELETED}`; `ResponseUrlNotificationMetadata`; `ResponseGoogleIndexingBatch`; `GoogleApiError::{Connection, JsonParse, HttpStatus, InvalidArgument}`. Every method takes an OAuth 2.0 access token as `&str`; the crate does not obtain tokens (use `yup-oauth2` or `gcp_auth` with scope `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/indexing`).

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/uiuifree/rust-google-indexing-api/blob/main/README.md): overview, installation, code examples, FAQ
- [API reference on docs.rs](https://docs.rs/google-indexing-api): rustdoc for every public item
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/uiuifree/rust-google-indexing-api/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): version history and breaking changes
- [examples/publish.rs](https://github.com/uiuifree/rust-google-indexing-api/blob/main/examples/publish.rs): notify one URL and read its metadata
- [examples/batch.rs](https://github.com/uiuifree/rust-google-indexing-api/blob/main/examples/batch.rs): notify many URLs in one request
